answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond that grows along a ridge: the first identity costs little, but every additional identity linked by shared funding, timing, or behaviour must post a separate, larger bond held for many epochs. Like basalt against a tide, a single account withstands scrutiny cheaply, yet a farm must lock real capital for every clone and loses all linked bonds if juries prove coordination, so splitting cannot share or parallelise the cost.
